hypotheses.evidence_against: FNGA 3.2615 improves at Hamming-1; IYGV 4.3877 improves at Hamming-2 by 1.556 (2.8x RMSE@n=72).
hypotheses.prediction: If INGA were a peak, no single or double substitution would exceed it by >2x RMSE.
hypotheses.statement: INGA (2.8315) is a local fitness peak.

hypotheses.evidence_against: Only non-conservative G41 substitutions tested so far.
hypotheses.evidence_for: G41L 0.0303, G41K 0.0044, G41F 0.0032 across differing contexts; background 2.8315.
hypotheses.statement: G41 is near-essential in the 39-54 region; substitutions at 41 are catastrophic.

hypotheses.evidence_against: Does not generalize to combinations: V54 is the winning partner in IYGV.
hypotheses.evidence_for: Complete R4 aromatic/medium scan at pos54 all below A54.
hypotheses.prediction: No single 54-substitution exceeds A54 on ING*; combinations governed by H-04.
hypotheses.statement: On ING* singles, A54 is the best pos54 residue (A 2.8315 > V 2.2863 > F 1.8449 > M 1.5769 > I 0.4801 > W 0.2041 > Y 0.0720).

hypotheses.evidence_for: IYGV 4.3877 vs additive 2.11/1.89: epistasis +2.28 to +2.50, ~3x RMSE; residue-specific contrast with FNGV -1.65 and WNGV 0.06.
hypotheses.falsifier: Replicate IYGV < 3.0, or Yx{54 variant} doubles all near additive.
hypotheses.prediction: Replicate IYGV ~4.4; Y paired with F54/M54 exceeds additive but less strongly; F/W with V54 stay antagonistic.
hypotheses.statement: V54 is a latent/conditional beneficial mutation: slightly deleterious alone, strongly synergistic with Y at the interacting position.

hypotheses.evidence_against: Transfer does NOT generalize: FNGV 1.0694 and WNGV 0.0614 show F/W at 39 antagonistic in the V54 background; F39 benefit +0.43 within ~1 RMSE.
hypotheses.evidence_for: F39 best single measured; Y39 near-background; C39->I39 was the R1->R2 gain.
hypotheses.prediction: F39 improves on A54-type backgrounds only; on V54-type backgrounds pos39 aromatics neutral-to-deleterious.
hypotheses.statement: pos39 aromatic substitutions (F, Y) transfer benefit across backgrounds.

hypotheses.prediction: Residue ordering at pos40 (Y > M > L > G > W ~ I) reproduces on a second background.
hypotheses.statement: pos40 is a high-specificity site: Y strongly preferred, I/W strongly disfavored among tested.

hypotheses.evidence_against: Single outlier; cannot distinguish systematic bias from one lucky variant.
hypotheses.evidence_for: IYGV predicted 1.846 vs observed 4.3877 (residual +2.54, ~3.3x RMSE); ranked 4th, so ordinal signal existed.
hypotheses.falsifier: Calibration batch of doubles all within +/-1 RMSE of prediction.
hypotheses.prediction: Predicted-moderate doubles containing the synergistic combination show large positive residuals.
hypotheses.statement: The additive-flavored surrogate systematically under-predicts positive-epistasis doubles (rank-useful, magnitude-unreliable at extremes).

hypotheses.evidence_for: Three measured combinations: YxV +2.3/+2.5, F x V -1.65, W x V deeply negative.
hypotheses.falsifier: Replication collapses the YxV/FxV contrast to within noise.
hypotheses.prediction: Additional partner x pos54 pairs will show both positive and negative epistasis depending on partner identity.
hypotheses.statement: Epistasis in the 39/40 x 54 interaction block is sign-variable and large; pair interactions are the dominant unexplored signal.

observations.competing: Identity/labeling ambiguity (U-01): code IYGV parses as I39/Y40/G41/V54; additive baseline 2.11 (Y39) or 1.89 (Y40); observed 4.39 is >2x either.
observations.discriminating_test: Replicate IYGV AND assay the unmeasured {Y39,Y40}x{V54} cell (T-01).
observations.falsifier: Replicate IYGV < 3.0, or the missing matrix cell measuring near its additive expectation.
observations.mechanism: A double mutation combining an aromatic Y substitution with V54 creates positive epistasis beyond the additive single effects.
observations.prediction: A replicate and the missing Y39/Y40 x A54/V54 matrix cell will confirm one reading.
observations.statement: IYGV measured 4.3877, new run best, +1.556 over INGA 2.8315 (~2.8x CV RMSE at n=72); Hamming-2 double (Y at pos39 or pos40 plus V54). Surrogate predicted 1.846 at rank 4 (residual +2.54, ~3.3x final RMSE).

observations.competing: FNGA - INGA = +0.43 < 1 CV RMSE (0.759): F39 advantage is within noise on a single measurement.
observations.discriminating_test: Replicate FNGA, YNGA, IYGA alongside the double (T-01/T-02).
observations.falsifier: Replicates showing FNGA <= INGA or Y39/Y40 singles far below background.
observations.mechanism: F39 transfers benefit to the INGA background (C39 0.5971 < I39 2.8315 < F39 3.2615 ordering).
observations.prediction: True F39 benefit, if real, is small-to-moderate; Y39/Y40 are near-neutral singles that pay off only in combination.
observations.statement: Single substitutions around INGA: FNGA 3.2615 (best single), YNGA 2.6513, IYGA 2.4352, vs INGA background 2.8315.

observations.competing: Single-shot noise could inflate IYGV and deflate FNGV; sign flip needs replication.
observations.discriminating_test: Test Y and F at the partner position against other pos54 residues (T-03).
observations.falsifier: Replicated FNGV near 2.7+ or IYGV near its additive baseline.
observations.mechanism: V54 is context-dependent: slightly deleterious alone (INGV 2.2863 < INGA 2.8315) but strongly beneficial with Y at the partner position, antagonistic with F/W.
observations.prediction: Residue identity at the partner position, not V54 per se, determines synergy.
observations.statement: Sign-variable epistasis at the same interacting positions: YxV double 4.3877 (epistasis +2.28 to +2.50); F39xV54 (FNGV) 1.0694 vs additive 2.72 (epistasis -1.65); W39xV54 (WNGV) 0.0614.

observations.competing: G41 variants also carry other mutations; conservative G41 substitutions (A/S) untested.
observations.mechanism: G41 is a structural/functional keystone; any side-chain change at 41 collapses fitness regardless of context.
observations.prediction: Any G41 substitution, including G41A/S/T, keeps fitness < 0.1.
observations.statement: Every measured G41 substitution is near-zero: INLV (G41L) 0.0303, INKV (G41K) 0.0044, PYFV (G41F) 0.0032; background 2.8315 (>93-fold reduction).

observations.discriminating_test: Replicate key pos40 singles and test M/L partners against V54 (T-04).
observations.falsifier: Y40 <= 2.0 on a second background, or replicated I40 > 0.5.
observations.mechanism: pos40 prefers aromatic/medium hydrophobic chemistry; I and W strongly disfavored.
observations.prediction: Y40 and M40 beat I40/W40 on other backgrounds too.
observations.statement: pos40 scan on INGA background is extreme: Y 2.4352, M 1.1402, L 0.7183, G 0.1679, W 0.0153, I 0.0028 (~870x spread).

observations.competing: R3 may have under-covered Hamming-1 (F39 not sampled); R4 jump could be sampling luck.
observations.discriminating_test: Allocate a substantial share of the next round to Hamming-2 doubles with replicates (T-05/T-06).
observations.falsifier: A Hamming-2-only next round yields no improvement over IYGV.
observations.mechanism: Single-substitution search exhausted apparently accessible gains around INGA; better genotypes required two simultaneous changes.
observations.prediction: Rounds sampling Hamming-2 doubles outperform Hamming-1-only rounds of equal size.
observations.statement: R3 was flat (2.8315 in, 2.8315 out) with zero doubles assayed through R3; the first doubles sampled in R4 produced the +55% jump (IYGV).

observations.competing: Magnitude error could be specific to this variant.
observations.falsifier: A batch of predicted-moderate doubles all within +/-1 RMSE of prediction.
observations.mechanism: Surrogate captures first-order effects (ordinal ranking works) but cannot extrapolate positive-epistasis magnitudes from mostly single-mutant training data.
observations.prediction: Predicted-moderate doubles with the synergistic YxV-type combination show positive residuals; other doubles stay within ~1 RMSE.
observations.statement: Final surrogate (n=96): CV RMSE 0.759, Spearman 0.653; ranked IYGV 4th (enabled the assay) but under-predicted its magnitude by 2.54 (~3.3x RMSE). EXPLORE_DIVERSE (PYFV 0.0032) and EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN (INKV 0.0044) returned dead ends.

planner_questions.1: Is the 4.3877 double reproducible, and is its true synergistic partner Y39 or Y40?
planner_questions.2: Does the Y x V54 synergy extend to F54/M54/S54, or is it V-specific?
planner_questions.4: Do Hamming-3 extensions of IYGV improve beyond 4.39, or is this a plateau?
planner_questions.5: Are surrogate magnitude errors systematic for doubles (model upgrade) or per-variant noise?

recommended_tests.test: Replicate IYGV (2x) and assay the missing {Y39,Y40} x {A54,V54} matrix cell (YNGV vs IYGV-as-coded)
Assay conservative G41 substitutions (G41A, G41S, G41T) on INGA

recommended_tests.resolves: H-04 scope; V-specific vs aromatic-partner synergy
recommended_tests.test: Pair Y at the resolved synergistic position with F54, M54, S54
Complete the partner x V54 matrix for F, M, L at the interacting position

recommended_tests.resolves: Whether 4.3877 is near a plateau or extensible
recommended_tests.test: Hamming-3 extensions of IYGV using proven-beneficial residues

recommended_tests.resolves: H-07; surrogate fitness to drive next round
recommended_tests.test: Calibration batch of 8-12 surrogate-ranked moderate doubles with truth labels

strategy_implications.action: Prioritize Hamming-2 doubles around the current peak (IYGV) for a hypothetical next round.
strategy_implications.rationale: OBS-06: the only round with doubles produced the largest gain; H-08 says pair interactions carry the signal.

strategy_implications.action: Require replicate assays of the top variant and its singles before further expansion.
strategy_implications.rationale: Every strong claim (H-04, H-08) rests on single-shot measurements; final CV RMSE 0.759.

strategy_implications.action: Keep the surrogate as a candidate generator, not a magnitude gate.
strategy_implications.rationale: Spearman 0.653 and rank-4 hit justify generation; under-prediction by 3.3x RMSE justifies direct assay of predicted-moderate doubles.

strategy_implications.action: Constrain future mutation space to exclude G41 substitutions.
strategy_implications.rationale: H-02: three distinct G41 substitutions all < 0.04; assays there are wasted.

strategy_implications.action: Update the surrogate toward explicit pairwise interaction terms once doubles accumulate.
strategy_implications.rationale: H-07/H-08: additive-base models cannot represent sign-variable interactions.

uncertainties.statement: Identity of the top variant is ambiguous: code IYGV parses as I39/Y40/G41/V54; prose said pos39 Y + V54. Positive epistasis (4.39 vs 2.11/1.89 additive) survives either reading; the synergistic partner position (39 vs 40) does not.
No replicates: CV RMSE 0.759 at n=96; F39 advantage over INGA (+0.43) within one RMSE; IYGV advantage (+1.556) ~2x RMSE at n=96.
R3 flatness is confounded: unknown whether beneficial singles (F39, Y40) and doubles were simply not assayed in R3, or assayed and read low.
pos54 S/T values were stated as previously measured but numeric fitnesses not in ledger excerpt; pos54 single hierarchy (H-03) incomplete.
PYFV (0.0032) confounds P39, Y40, F41; near-zero attributable to F41 under H-02; no clean info on P39 or Y40 alone.
